_description: 상대 날짜를 LLM이 아닌 runtime이 절대 범위로 정규화하는 한국어 정책이다.

rules.내일: reference local date plus one day
rules.이번 주: monday through sunday containing the reference date
rules.다음 주: monday through sunday after the reference week
rules.이번 주말: next complete saturday-sunday pair; on saturday or sunday use the following weekend
rules.다음 주말: saturday-sunday pair after the next complete weekend
rules.이번 달: first through last day of the reference calendar month
rules.다음 달: first through last day of the next calendar month
rules.올해: january 1 through december 31 of the reference calendar year
rules.내년: january 1 through december 31 of the next calendar year
